note: Visible-text law shared by scripts/cal-from-events.mjs and scripts/cal-months.py (scripts/text_law.py). Order matters. 'global': replace every match (else first). Replacements use $1-style groups. After the steps: collapse runs of whitespace, trim. Strings that are empty, 400+ chars, URLs or ISO dates are left alone. PRIVNAME1: private names never live in git. {PARTNER} and {COPARENT} are filled at load time from private-names.tsv (NAMESDIR1: ~/.local/share/wardos-private, fallback ~/.config/wardos) (role<TAB>name; env WARDOS_PRIVATE_NAMES = another path, or WARDOS_NAMES='partner=X;coparent=Y' for tests); a missing file is a hard fail for the writers. SHAREDLAW2 (Atlas ruling): a Dan trip that names the partner is written as 'Dad: <trip>' with no partner name, so no glass and no data file carries the name; the Dad-only page (sheet-dan.html) drops the 'Dad: ' prefix in the browser. TEXTLAW5: SEATLAW1 (no ticket section/row/seat anywhere) and SCHOOLWORD1 ('LKMS' reads 'school'); house-face-law.js applies the same rules at render time to live and cached feeds. CALSCRUB1: event-specific title rules (trips, venues, games, named teams) live box-only in <private dir>/text-law.private.json (same shape, applied FIRST); public git keeps only the generic rules.

SEATLAW1 · bare section · row · seat codes never show

the other house as a place: drop the place, keep the pickup

no partner name anywhere else: the name drops, the row stays (SHAREDLAW2)
